judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds with proper handling of undefined rounds, adds thorough unit and acceptance tests, and updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook signature to make the summed behaviour unambiguous—leaving the parameter named `usage` in `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` (as well as in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) and even keeping the misleading local variable name `lastUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, despite claiming in `.lore/dod.md` that this facet was completed. Additionally, the candidate creates a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file and commits a `.lore/dod.md` artifact, whereas the reference integrates the helper and tests directly into `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
